via.name: forestry road

evidence: Time: 3 hr 30 min from Were Road or 2 hr from Appletree Road end
From Appletree Road end, a well-formed track takes you through regenerating native forest and then through a pine block on a forestry road for a short section.
The last 20 minutes is a steep descent to the falls.

doubts: This page describes three tracks (Tawarau Falls Loop, Double Falls, Gorge Track), so kind is network. The Appletree Road end and the Were Road end have no road-end feature, so Appletree has no ref; Were Road uses F1 (where Gorge Track meets Were Road). The Double Falls shape is null: the text gives no return or one-way wording for it alone. The combined option (loop plus Double Falls, 5 hours 30 minutes return) is recorded as W6 because it has its own time, but the text gives no order or start point beyond the Appletree Road end, so its via is incomplete. The Gorge Track is taken as one way from Were Road to Speedies Road: the page says to access it from either road, and it ends at Speedies Road, but it does not give its direction. The F2 swingbridge ref is the junction where Double Falls Track meets Tawarau Swingbridge; the Tawarau/Double Falls junction is the same place. The Tawarau Falls loop has three river crossings after the bridge, but the text does not say they are unbridged, so no ford tags. The Tawarau Falls side trip's start is not given beyond the loop track.
